Evaluation across 500 store-item time series. XGBoost evaluated globally with autoregressive lag features; Prophet evaluated on sample series; Baseline represents a 7-day moving average.
Key Takeaway: The global XGBoost model achieves an accuracy lift of 60.8% error reduction over baseline by capturing cross-series patterns, day-of-week seasonality, and momentum lags.
Two-tailed Z-score outlier detector (|Z| > 2.0). Flags unusual demand surges or stockout dips to protect autoregressive lags from distortion.
